#!/usr/bin/env bash

ExecStart=/opt/sentinel/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
SERVICE
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now sentinel.service
echo "[4/4] Bootstrap completado exitosamente."
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/bootstrap_sentinel.sh && /tmp/bootstrap_sentinel.sh [/EXECUTE]
